Become a Mars astronaut

You are the Commander of a small crew rocket. Land on Mars, look after your crew and build a home where people can live.

Your missions

  1. Choose where to land

    Type your name, then pick the place on Mars where your rocket will touch down.

  2. Power the base

    Solar panels give the base electricity. Meet Kai and decide how to build them.

  3. Keep the air safe to breathe

    Mars has no air for people. Nova looks after the oxygen and water.

  4. Build a safe home

    Rex builds the habitat dome. Every choice you make changes the next day (Sol) on Mars.

  • WASD or arrow keys to walk
  • Shift to run
  • E to talk to the crew or fix a machine
  • Space to jump
